Promotion System

Principal, Deputy and Curriculum Master only. Promotion keeps old marks and saves history.

Click Preview Promotion to see affected students.

Promotion Rules

Class promotion:
Form 3S → Form 4
Form 3N → Form 4
Form 4 → Completed
Grade 10S → Grade 11S
Grade 10N → Grade 11N
Term promotion:
Term 1 → Term 2
Term 2 → Term 3
Term 3 → Next Year/Class
